value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "For researchers with longstanding commitments to careful development of instructional materials and professional learning programs through co-design with teachers and multiple cycles of development, classroom testing, third-party review, and revision, this was a stunning request."
